title: Grilling in public places
question: Can I grill or make a barbecue in a public park in Poland?
short_answer: Generally prohibited in public parks unless in designated areas.
conditions: Grilling is allowed only in designated zones marked with barbecue signs
Some parks have dedicated grilling areas with permanent grills
On private land, grilling is generally permitted with neighbour consideration
Use of portable gas/charcoal grills may be allowed in some recreation areas
exceptions: Designated barbecue zones in parks and recreation areas
penalties: Fine: up to 500 PLN for unsanctioned open fire in public spaces
Fine: up to 5000 PLN for starting a fire in a forest
Additional liability for any damage caused by fire
